_notice: FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. Every person below is invented. Record numbers use a DEMO- prefix so they can never be mistaken for real member IDs. Do not add real client information to this file — it is published to the public prototype.

clients.name: James Carter
clients.background: Osteoarthritis, chronic low-back pain and reduced endurance. Ambulates with a rolling walker. Fall in the home three months ago with no fracture. Uses a shower chair.
clients.demoFocus: Baseline moderate-dependence case

clients.name: Linda Moore
clients.background: Moderate dementia with intermittent disorientation to place and time. Requires cueing through most self-care tasks. Wanders in the evening. Continent with prompting.
clients.demoFocus: Cueing-led profile — mostly score 2, routes to ECLS

clients.name: Robert Ellis
clients.background: Right hemiparesis following stroke eight months ago. Transfers with contact-guard assistance. Indwelling catheter. Independent with eating once the tray is set up.
clients.demoFocus: Catheter care only — toileting still permitted

clients.name: Gloria Bennett
clients.background: Congestive heart failure with marked exertional dyspnoea. Requires seated rest breaks during bathing and dressing. Independent cognitively. No lifeline device in the home.
clients.demoFocus: Endurance-limited — long task times at moderate scores

clients.name: Marcus Webb
clients.background: Progressive multiple sclerosis. Non-ambulatory, uses a power wheelchair. Transfers require two people or a mechanical lift. Upper-limb weakness limits self-feeding late in the day.
clients.demoFocus: High dependence — exercises the 20-hour supervisor co-signature threshold

clients.name: Hattie Nguyen
clients.informalSupport: Son and daughter-in-law provide most hands-on care
clients.background: General frailty without cognitive impairment. Performs most self-care with setup and verbal encouragement. Family provides bathing and laundry assistance without payment.
clients.demoFocus: Informal-support heavy — most time recorded but excluded from authorization

clients.name: Curtis Zhao
clients.background: Type 2 diabetes with diabetic retinopathy and substantial vision loss. Requires assistance drawing and verifying insulin doses four times daily. Otherwise independent with mobility.
clients.demoFocus: Medication-dominant — exercises the uncapped 'No Limit' rule

clients.name: Rosalind Pike
clients.background: Parkinson's disease with pronounced tremor and bradykinesia. Meals take substantially longer than typical. Freezing episodes during transfers. Medication timing is critical.
clients.demoFocus: Meals-per-day multiplier — exercises the cap-semantics question

clients.name: Elena Duarte
clients.background: T6 spinal cord injury. Manages an intermittent catheter programme and colostomy care. Independent with upper-body dressing. Requires full assistance with lower-body dressing and transfers.
clients.demoFocus: Catheter AND colostomy — triggers the toileting supersession hard block

clients.name: Walter Kimani
clients.background: Advanced dementia. Fully dependent in all activities of daily living. Requires repositioning through the night to prevent skin breakdown. Does not initiate any self-care.
clients.demoFocus: Total dependence plus complex skin care

clients.name: Trisha Okafor
clients.background: Traumatic brain injury with impaired task initiation and sequencing. Physically capable of self-care but requires step-by-step prompting throughout. Intermittently refuses care.
clients.demoFocus: Cueing versus hands-on — exercises the supervision double-count advisory

clients.name: Benjamin Stroud
clients.background: Severe COPD on continuous supplemental oxygen. Tolerates only brief activity before requiring rest. Bathing is split across two sessions. Requires assistance managing oxygen tubing during transfers.
clients.demoFocus: Bathing soft-cap advisory (45 min/day guidance)

clients.name: Nadia Alvarez
clients.background: Six weeks after total hip replacement. Posterior hip precautions in force. Requires assistance with lower-body dressing, bathing and toilet transfers. Expected to improve substantially.
clients.demoFocus: Temporary elevated need — reassessment-driven case

clients.name: Samuel Reece
clients.background: Dysphagia following a brainstem stroke. Receives all nutrition via feeding tube, four administrations daily. Requires suctioning during and after feeds. Non-verbal but responsive.
clients.demoFocus: Complex care — feeding tube and suctioning, PCS-only routing

clients.name: Yolanda Frey
clients.background: Class III obesity with bilateral lymphoedema and limited standing tolerance. All transfers require a mechanical lift and two caregivers. Skin care to lower limbs twice daily.
clients.demoFocus: Two-person and mechanical-lift case — no source rule exists for this yet

clients.name: Peter Halloran
clients.background: Independent with all personal care. Requires assistance only with medication organisation and transport to appointments. Assessed to confirm continued low level of need.
clients.demoFocus: Low-need case — most tasks score 1, near-zero authorization

clients.name: Ingrid Solberg
clients.background: Neurogenic bowel requiring a scheduled bowel programme every other day. Stage 2 pressure area over the sacrum requiring repositioning and preventive massage. Limited bed mobility.
clients.demoFocus: Bowel programme and specialised skin care — alternate-day scheduling

clients.name: Terrell Banks
clients.background: C4 complete spinal cord injury, ventilator dependent. Requires total assistance in all activities. Frequent suctioning. Range-of-motion programme delivered twice daily by a caregiver.
clients.demoFocus: Ventilator — a service with no state-determined limit

clients.name: Maria Castellanos
clients.informalSupport: Daughter provides bathing, dressing and all meal preparation
clients.background: Rheumatoid arthritis with significant hand deformity. Requires hands-on assistance with buttons, fasteners and food preparation. Family currently meets most of this need unpaid.
clients.demoFocus: Informal support versus paid authorization — the IFS exclusion rule

clients.name: Arthur Penny
clients.background: Physically independent with a cane. Increasing forgetfulness around medication and appliances. Family concerned about safety alone but no formal dementia diagnosis recorded.
clients.demoFocus: General supervision case — exercises the ECLS bucket
